title: Hardship Settlement Extension Allowance by Booked Settlement Amount
content:
# Hardship Settlement — Size Allowance

**Rule.** For a due-date extension on an accepted Hardship Settlement of Ridgeline's Settlement Agreements, where the settlement amount booked to the Hardship Settlement on acceptance is 1500.00 dollars or more, the Hardship Settlement size allowance of 3 days is added; where it is at least 500.00 dollars but under 1500.00 dollars, the size allowance is 2 days; a booked amount under 500.00 dollars earns no size allowance.

The booked amount is the settlement amount entered in the settlement's payment history on the acceptance date; payments received since do not change it.

| Settlement amount booked on acceptance | Size allowance |
|---|---|
| 1500.00 dollars or more | 3 days |
| 500.00 to 1499.99 dollars | 2 days |
| under 500.00 dollars | none |

Hypothetical edges: 1500.00 dollars booked earns 3 days, 1499.99 dollars earns 2; 500.00 dollars earns 2, 499.99 dollars earns none.
